loci.description: Autosomal recessive disease (genetics specification 3.2, model: cystic fibrosis); the locus of the walking skeleton, renamed at the same place.
MC1R, a large recessive pigment locus (genetics specification 10.4, ADR-0020 section 1).
Autosomal dominant disease of late onset (genetics specification 3.2, model: Huntington's disease).
HERC2, a large recessive pigment locus (genetics specification 10.4, ADR-0020 section 1).
Autosomal dominant disease with partial penetrance by sex (genetics specification 3.2, model: BRCA1).
X-linked recessive disease (genetics specification 3.2, model: haemophilia A); men with one copy on their X are affected.
Mitochondrial disease (genetics specification 3.2, model: Leber hereditary optic neuropathy); one copy, from the mother.
